subject: Weekend idea
text: Hi there, I am really looking forward to your first week, and I wanted to share my weekend plan for a little fun. On Saturday, I will visit a neighborhood market, grab a quiet coffee, and then tidy my workspace so I can start Monday refreshed. My small suggestion for you is to set a simple checklist before your onboarding call; it keeps questions from slipping. I hope your weekend feels calm and pleasant. If anything feels unclear on the portal, just reply to this note.
